plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Spec-driven development, end to end. The spec settles what to build; a gitignored YAML plan settles how, and neither is rewritten to agree with the code afterwards. One question — dispatched subagents or inline — then the round runs without stopping: ready tasks go out in batches, in parallel where their files are disjoint, each a mandatory red-green-refactor round with a reproduction-first route for every fault. With subagents, no task is done on its implementer's word: that commit is read by a second subagent, against the task's goal, the project's conventions and the code, and that same subagent fixes what it finds, one TDD round per finding, reporting the findings with it. Wrap-up is two more dispatched reviews at once over the whole branch, one against the spec and one on the code, fixed and re-reviewed to a ceiling of three rounds, ending in a verification report that shows the user how to reproduce it themselves. Plus init, which establishes the project's agent constraint system: AGENTS.md and layered docs, lint guardrails wired into CI, and the twin unit-test and e2e tracks. A SessionStart hook puts the bootstrap into every session.
